newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Tyre half-year net up 47.5 pc.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Tyre half-year net up 47.5 pc.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures) Turnover 2,010.741 vs 1,839.091
Net asset per share 2.77 yuan vs 2.70 yuan
Earnings per share 0.090 yuan vs 0.061 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Tyre and Rubber Co Ltd
Note: The results were contained in a company statement in the Shanghai Securities News on Friday.

The figures are unaudited, as Chinese securities rules do not require listed firms to have their interim results audited. Trading in the company's A and B shares would be suspended on Friday morning and would resume in the afternoon.
